Author: alizea1337
Name: Keystroke
Punchline: Automates Keybound Brawler typing with humanized input, auto-queue and reward tracking.
Description: Keystroke reads Keybound Brawler prompts and types the answers for you, with humanized timing by default and an optional instant mode. Auto-queue loops with stop conditions, opens Keybound Coffers, tracks MGP/MGC gains, warns before the MGC cap, and offers global hotkeys and a compact in-duty overlay. Open /keystroke to get started.
Changelog:
New interface. A bevelled charcoal frame with a drifting cyan-lime-gold signal stripe, an icon
rail, and pages laid out as group boxes with cut-in titles. Checkbox rows, thin accent sliders,
inset fields, bevel buttons. The word being typed is shown as keycaps that press down as keys go
out, on the dashboard, the compact strip and the overlay. Six selectable accents; effects and
reduce-motion switches on the new "look" page. DejaVu Sans replaces Inter.

Author: alizea1337
Name: Provenance
Punchline: Turns a Teamcraft list into finished items: gathers, buys and crafts every material for you.
Description: Provenance takes a Teamcraft list (link, copied text or import string) or items you pick in its recipe browser, works out every material down to the crystals, then gets everything and crafts it in one run: items from your retainers, master books and folklore tomes from scrip exchanges (earning the scrips with collectables when needed), vendors, monster drops with a basic combo, gathering through GatherBuddy Reborn including timed nodes, and crafting with Raphael rotations. No market board. Requires GatherBuddy Reborn and vnavmesh (AutoHook for fishing). Open /provenance to get started.
Changelog:
- Specialist crafters: intermediates no longer fail with "Raphael found no rotation". raphael-cli
  crashes when offered Heart and Soul / Quick Innovation for a rotation that needs no quality, so
  those are only offered when quality is wanted.
- Raphael errors show the real reason instead of Rust's backtrace hint; an internal error is retried
  without the specialist actions, then without Manipulation, and only "no solution" keeps a run
  from starting. A craft that needs no quality and still can't be planned is finished with Basic
  Synthesis instead of stopping the run.
- Plan page: "Your character can't do this yet" and "Get these yourself" rows have a Remove button
  that takes the ordered items needing that material out of the order (the tooltip names them),
  plus "Remove all" for everything the character can't do.
